description: Internal engineering knowledge base: architecture notes, code index, and config reference for a single-file Python tool.
rules: The main script is 'autosp main branch v6.py'; it loads the backend 'autosp mainbranch v3.py' in-process via _load_backend().
For function/class locations, use the code index at docs/code-index.md first, then grep the exact symbol if the line looks stale.
Pickup naming callbacks run in BackendManager; read pickup data (_pickup_log, _pickup_names, _drop_items) via self.mgr, never self.
Do NOT modify 'autosp mainbranch v3.py' (loaded read-only).
Validate with: python -m py_compile "autosp main branch v6.py"
